h1: Charoenkrung Place — A Budget Hotel with a Pool in the Heart of Charoen Krung
intro: If you want a good-value base in the Charoen Krung-Bang Kho Laem area that comes with a pool and a fitness room, Charoenkrung Place is worth a look — 10 Soi Mahaisawan 6, a 5-minute walk from Sala Chalermkrung Royal Theatre and under 1 km from Asiatique The Riverfront. A 3-star hotel with 168 rooms, some with balconies looking over the city, and prices from about ฿900/night. Its average score of 6.1 from real reviews says this hotel has both genuine strengths and things you'll want to know before booking.

body.html: Soi Mahaisawan 6 is an area most tourists probably don't know well, but it sits on the old Charoen Krung axis — the first road in Thailand built to a Western design — surrounded by architectural heritage, trading streets, and long-standing communities that still carry the pulse of old Bangkok. Charoenkrung Place was built as a 168-room 3-star hotel for both short-stay and monthly guests, hosting international travellers and Thais alike who want a base in this part of town.

Location is the most interesting thing here. Sala Chalermkrung Royal Theatre, a classic performance hall open since 1933, is just a 5-minute walk away. Asiatique The Riverfront, the riverside night market on the Chao Phraya that travellers love, is about 1 km away. And the Creative District — Warehouse 30 and TCDC — is within easy reach by public transport, though it takes a bit of walking or a short Grab ride to get there.
"Good location, very convenient for Asiatique, and the room was clean — but there was a fair amount of noise from the surroundings."

There are two main room types, King Bedroom and Twin Room. Some have a private balcony with a city view, blackout curtains, air conditioning, and cable channels. The main facilities that set this place apart from the hostels in the same area are the outdoor pool and the fitness room — rarely found at this price. The hotel restaurant is open, and there's a shared kitchen for guests who want to cook for themselves.

That said, to be honest, the 6.1 score comes with feedback from real reviews you should hear first: some guests mention poor soundproofing — noise from neighbouring rooms or from outside can carry. One review notes there's no kettle in the room, which some travellers consider a basic. And check-in closes at 6:00 PM, a significant limitation if you're arriving on a late flight.

For anyone planning to explore the Charoen Krung area and Asiatique, this is a stop with a pool at a rate clearly below the big riverside hotels. From about ฿900–1,200/night depending on the season and room type. If you spend most of your time out of the hotel and come back mainly to sleep and swim, Charoenkrung Place offers reasonable value for the price. But if you want a boutique atmosphere or attentive, detail-focused service, you'll need to set your expectations to match the price.

Compared with the hotels and hostels in the same area, Charoenkrung Place has one clear selling point that its price-range rivals rarely offer: a swimming pool with a fitness room. For guests who want to work out or unwind in the pool after a day out, without paying riverside-resort rates, that's a genuine, tangible advantage.

honestSummary: Charoenkrung Place is a budget 3-star hotel whose strengths are its pool, fitness room, and location near Sala Chalermkrung and Asiatique, at a price where comparable hotels usually cost more. That said, its average score of 6.1 reflects inconsistent soundproofing, in-room amenities, and service — if you're expecting a boutique standard or high-end service, you may be disappointed.
honestChecks: If you're a light sleeper who needs quiet — reviews mention noise from neighbouring rooms and outside the building. Try requesting a higher floor on the side away from the main road before you book.
If your flight arrives after 6:00 PM — check-in closes at 6:00 PM per the hotel's policy. Contact the hotel in advance to give your ETA and confirm the policy.

If you want fully stocked in-room amenities like a kettle, minibar, or included breakfast — breakfast isn't included here and rooms may lack some items. Plan to pick up supplies from a nearby convenience store yourself.

tips.title: See Khon at Sala Chalermkrung
tips.body: This 90-year-old theatre is a 5-minute walk away and stages Khon (masked dance drama), a UNESCO world-heritage art form you rarely get to see in Bangkok — book tickets in advance via the official website.

tips.title: Walk or Take a Motorbike Taxi to Asiatique
tips.body: Asiatique The Riverfront is about 1 km away — a pleasant evening walk, or a motorbike taxi for under 10 baht. The market opens from 5:00 PM.

tips.title: Use the Pool in the Morning
tips.body: The outdoor pool is usually quiet in the mornings — make the most of it before heading out. Plan to be back at the hotel before 6:00 PM if you're checking in on your first day.

tips.title: Tell the Hotel if You'll Arrive Late
tips.body: Check-in closes at 6:00 PM. If your flight lands late or you're stuck in traffic, contact the hotel in advance to confirm a late check-in directly.

faq.q: Where is Charoenkrung Place and is it near the BTS or express boat?
faq.a: The hotel is at 10 Soi Mahaisawan 6, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok. It's about 2.5 km from BTS Saphan Taksin (~8 min by Grab), and Talat Phlu MRT is around 3 km away. Asiatique runs a free shuttle boat from Sathorn Pier in the evenings, which is very handy for getting to and from.

faq.q: How much does Charoenkrung Place cost per night?
faq.a: Rates start at about ฿900–1,100/night for a standard King or Twin room. Rooms with a balcony view cost a little more. Prices depend on the season and the platform you book on — always compare on Agoda and Trip.com.

faq.q: Does Charoenkrung Place have a pool? Is it free to use?
faq.a: Yes, there's an outdoor pool and a fitness room. These facilities are included in the room rate — a key strength that sets this hotel apart from the hostels in the same area.

faq.q: Who is Charoenkrung Place best suited to?
faq.a: It suits travellers who want a hotel with a pool at a budget price and plan to explore the Charoen Krung area, Sala Chalermkrung, and Asiatique. It's not ideal for anyone wanting boutique service or a very quiet room.

faq.q: What time does check-in close at Charoenkrung Place?
faq.a: Check-in at Charoenkrung Place closes at 6:00 PM, unlike most hotels that operate 24 hours. If your flight arrives late or you expect to hit traffic, contact the hotel in advance to give your ETA and confirm your booking.
